worships.definition: The devotion accorded to a deity or to a sacred object.

worth.definition: Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wouldst.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wound.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

wounded.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

woven.definition: To form something by passing lengths or strands of material over and under one another.

wrath.definition: Great anger; (countable) an instance of this.

wrathful.definition: Possessed of great wrath; very angry.

wreath.definition: Senses relating to intertwining or twisting.

wreathed.definition: Senses relating to intertwining or twisting.

wrecked.definition: Something or someone that has been ruined.

wretch.definition: To make or experience an unsuccessful effort to vomit; to strain or spasm, as if to vomit; to gag or nearly vomit.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yard-arm.definition: The outer end of a yard, often equipped with blocks for reeving signal halyards.

ye.definition: The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

year.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

yearns.definition: To have a strong desire for something or to do something; to long for or to do something.

years.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yoke.definition: The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

younger.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zone.definition: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).
